workspace_label: Cantos research desk: Hot Aisle MI300X Run 3 (provisional seed)

case.title: What did one accepted coding request cost on a rented MI300X seat, and what would change that answer?
case.question: Under the registered raw-completion contract, arm A/T0 accepted 4,336 of 8,622 requests in its own 1.044 h window at the observed $2.99 list rate. Is $0.72 per 1,000 accepted requests the number to carry, and under which conditions?
three_minute_path: Read the recommendation and its conditions.
Open the evidence: the measurement is source-reported and never recomputed here; the economics record recomputes from the price record through the Compute engine.
Record a review with your name and rationale, then freeze the delivery.
Change the price assumption. The recommendation goes stale with the exact pin that moved; the measurement is untouched.
Recompute. A successor economics record and a draft successor recommendation appear; a fresh review is required before a second delivery.
Export the packet and restore it in a fresh browser: both deliveries and the full journal survive.

boundaries.evidence: Source identity and recomputable reasoning; not source truth. Measured counts are copied from the public Run 3 summary and are never recomputed by this page.
boundaries.review: Reviewer names are attributed, not authenticated. A review binds the exact dependency set and lapses when any pinned input changes.
boundaries.scenario: A price scenario is an assumption. It never refreshes provider supply, changes measured acceptance, or becomes a quote.
boundaries.export: The packet carries the whole journal and a SHA-256. Hash consistency detects change; it does not authenticate a publisher.

records.title: Run 3 summary: Hot Aisle MI300X arms (published 2026-09-24)
records.summary: Public campaign summary for Run 3 on one rented 1x MI300X VM. It reports per-arm request counts, registered and post-hoc correctness, TTFT percentiles and an own-window cost, and it records a cost correction against the earlier ledger figures.

limitations: One seat, one day, one model; not a population estimate.
The ledger's earlier modeled-lower-bound figures charged later arms for earlier arms' seat time; the summary's own-window figures supersede them.

records.title: Arm A/T0 measured result (registered raw-completion contract)
records.summary: 8,622 of 8,622 scheduled requests completed; 4,371 correct under the registered raw-completion grader; 4,336 accepted (50.3%) within the deadline. TTFT p50/p95/p99 = 53/155/571 ms. Post-hoc sanitised re-grading reaches 6,192 correct but is not the registered result.

window.basis: arm's own t_script_start to t_script_end, not the shared seat's t_ssh

identity.runtime: vLLM ROCm container; digest in the source summary

grading.registered: raw completion contract (stray fences, re-declared functions and test prints fail)

posthoc.label: post-hoc, not registered; shown for format-versus-capability context only

limitations: Registered correctness is dominated by output format, not model capability; the post-hoc figure is a separate, unregistered analysis.
TTFT percentiles come from the serving log of one arm on one seat.

records.title: Hot Aisle MI300X VM list price (reviewed 2026-09-23)
records.summary: $2.99 per GPU-hour for a new-customer 1x MI300X VM, billed by the minute, no stated minimum. Run 3 was paid from provider credit and costed at this list rate.

data.billing: per-minute list price; the seat was paid from provider credit
data.scope: one own-seat VM at list rate; not a whole-allocation invoice and not a negotiated price
limitations: A dated listing observation. It is not evidence of current availability or of future price.

records.title: Own-window seat cost per 1,000 accepted requests (A/T0)
records.summary: Compute.quote at the pinned list rate for the arm's own 1.044 h window, divided by the pinned accepted count. The number is filled and re-verified by the Compute engine, never typed.

limitations: Own-window cost only: smoke, setup and idle seat time are attributed separately (whole seat: 2.73 h, $8.15, 9,086 accepted across arms).

records.title: Scope: Second Run program, public evidence, no customer engagement
records.summary: This case uses retained public Run 3 evidence produced by the Second Run program. No customer, sponsor or endorsement is implied; the prospective viewer has not commissioned this work.

limitations: Funding: provider credit for the seat; no client budget.

records.title: Carry $0.72 per 1,000 accepted requests for A/T0, with conditions
records.summary: Carry $0.72 per 1,000 accepted requests as the own-window figure for arm A/T0 at the observed $2.99 list rate. It holds only under the registered raw-completion contract; the post-hoc sanitised figure is a format finding, not a capability claim. Whole-seat cost including smoke, setup and idle time is $0.90 per 1,000 accepted and must not be mixed with the own-window figure.

conditions: Registered raw-completion grading, not the post-hoc sanitised re-grade.
Own-window seat time (1.044 h), not the shared-seat clock.
List rate $2.99 per GPU-hour as observed 2026-09-23; any other rate is a scenario until observed.
holds_unless: The price record is revised or replaced by a scenario.
New measured evidence for the same identity is admitted.
data.template: Carry {usd_per_1k_accepted} per 1,000 accepted requests for A/T0 at {rate} per GPU-hour ({hours} h own window, {accepted} accepted). The registered-contract, own-window and list-rate conditions of the prior revision still apply.
